1.

O God, shall I be made like Thy Son, Fruit of Thy grace, so unspeakably rich? God of all grace, how deep Thy sea of love, Thou, who didst give Thine only Son for us!

2.

Thou gavest Him, and He in love took Our guilt upon Himself and patiently suffered and died. Now satisfied, O God, Thou dost rejoice In the Son, who for us hath sacrificed Himself.

3.

Thy thought great, O God, from eternity Was to bring us to glory, Yea, for Thy Son to have there a bride, For Him adorned in glorious, snow-white raiment.

4.

In the Lamb’s bride Thou now, O Father, seest The reward He gained for the cross’s anguish here; For her sake His soul hath laboured And found no rest until all was accomplished.

5.

We praise Thee, our Lord Jesus Christ! Grace, nothing but grace we see from first to last, Joint-heirs with Thee in glory, Thy image to reflect in eternity.
